facts.business: Karnataka Bank Limited is a commercial bank providing deposits, advances, and investment services with a focus on retail, mid-corporate, and large corporate lending, as well as priority sector and agricultural advances.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Bank has consistently maintained the CRAR ratio well above the minimum requirement of 11.50%, including the Capital Conservation Buffer of 2.50% stipulated by the Reserve Bank of India and the internal policy of the Bank of maintaining the CRAR 1.50% over and above the regulatory requirement.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text

key_risks: Decline in yield on advances following repricing of external benchmark-linked loans leading to compression in spreads
Increased provisioning towards NPA to improve Provision Coverage Ratio
Asset quality risk related to identification and provisioning for non-performing advances
